q1_issues.issue: The matrix verb 'spent' is not reified at all and its duration argument is folded onto the gerund event instead, whereas 'Two kinds of clause' reifies every verbal predicate and the light-verb exemption is written only for occurred / happened / took place over an event-noun.

q2_gaps: 'spend <duration> V-ing' — a light-verb duration construction with a gerund complement; nothing states whether the matrix 'spend' event is reified with the time span as its object or absorbed into a duration measure on the complement event
notes: Given that folding, the rest follows the instruction set exactly: bare-plural 'decades' takes MeasureAtLeast ... duration 2 decade, the non-specific object 'mainframes' takes the bare class symbol, Past is marked, and no Ongoing is emitted (a gerund complement is not one of the four licensed Ongoing markers).
